name: Inflection.io
description:
Inflection is a B2B marketing automation platform built for product-led companies — email campaigns, multi-step journeys, and segmentation driven by product usage and CRM data.

This connector gives Claude direct access to your Inflection workspace, so you can go from question to campaign without switching tools.

Create and manage campaign assets
Draft emails, build journeys, and define segments in plain language. Claude can create new assets, patch existing ones, render a live preview before anything ships, and search what's already in your workspace.

Understand your data
Browse your tenant's real data dictionary — entities, fields, value distributions — so campaigns are built against fields you actually have. Discover schemas across data domains, and look up individual contacts with their related records and activity.

Report on performance
Pull aggregate analytics for campaigns and journey rollups, or drill into per-entity breakdowns: recipient lists, top links, and conversion paths.

Work with agents
Dispatch specialist agents for building audiences, segments, emails, journeys, tokens and more. 

Good for marketers spinning up a campaign from a plain-English brief, ops teams auditing what's live, and anyone who'd rather ask for last quarter's journey performance than build the report by hand.

Requires an Inflection account. Access is scoped to your workspace and follows your existing workspace permissions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Inflection.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Inflection.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.inflection.io/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Inflection.io MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Inflection.io lists 18 MCP tools, including ask_agent, create_platform_asset, data_dictionary, delete_platform_asset, get_analytics_breakdown, get_analytics_report, get_artifacts, get_contact_info, get_knowledge, get_platform_asset, get_platform_context, and get_schema.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Inflection.io?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Inflection.io in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Inflection.io requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Inflection.io is developed by Inflection.io. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
